title: paulownia tomentosa
intro: Paulownia tomentosa, commonly known as the Princess Tree or Empress Tree, is a deciduous tree native to Asia. The health benefits of Paulownia tomentosa include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Paulownia tomentosa include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
